only.steam: Steam only: Telegram has no such thing.

check.title: Check accounts
check.lead: Check {{count}} account(s): whether the key still works, who is behind it, and whether it has Premium. No new authorization appears — the key the account already has is reused.
check.avatarHint: The picture is stored next to the account in the database folder. This is a read — the account does nothing.
check.spamHint: Sends /start to the bot from the account. It is what a real user would do, but it is still an action — hence a switch of its own.
check.sessionsHint: How many devices currently have access to the account.
check.spreadHint: Accounts go round-robin through every proxy instead of out from one address.
check.noProxy: No proxy is set up for Telegram — the whole batch goes out from your IP. Fifty accounts from one address is the quickest way to lose them.

profile.title: Filling profiles
profile.lead: Puts a name, a bio and a picture on {{count}} account(s). The @username is left alone: it is unique across all of Telegram, so freeing the old one hands it to whoever asks next and every link to the account breaks quietly.
profile.withNameHint: Ordinary names, agreeing with the gender. No pair is repeated within one run while there is still something to pick from.
profile.withBioHint: A short line under 70 characters, written without a past-tense verb — in Russian those carry gender and read as automated.
profile.noDirHint: No folder picked — the pictures stay as they are. Supported inside: .jpg, .png, .webp and .mp4 (an animated avatar). Add male and female subfolders and the picture will match the generated name.
profile.packFound: Found {{photos}} photo(s) and {{videos}} video(s). Every picture goes to its own account: repeats only start once the folder runs out.
profile.packGendered: {{male}} male, {{female}} female — matched to the generated name.

packError.empty: No usable pictures in this folder (.jpg, .png, .webp, .mp4 up to 10 MB).
packError.unreadable: The folder could not be read.

profile.replaceAvatarHint: Telegram stacks a new avatar on top of the old ones instead of replacing them — without this the previous owner's face is one swipe away.
profile.nothingToDo: Nothing to change: turn on the name or the bio, or pick a folder with avatars.

refused.no_avatars: No usable pictures in the chosen folder.

cleanup.title: Clearing chats and channels
cleanup.lead: Empties the dialog list on {{count}} account(s): the previous owner's subscriptions, their chats, their bots, their folders, their contacts.

targetHint.channels: Leaves the channel. A private one cannot be rejoined without a new invite.
targetHint.groups: Leaves the group and removes what is left of the dialog.
targetHint.bots: Deletes the conversation for yourself. The bot is not blocked.
targetHint.private: Deletes the conversation for yourself only — the other side keeps their copy.
targetHint.privateRevoke: Deletes the conversation on both sides — yours and theirs.
targetHint.saved: The previous owner's own notes: files, links, forwarded messages. A chat with itself — there is nobody else to delete it for.
targetHint.service: Chat 777000 and Telegram support: old login codes and warnings. Comes back empty at the next sign-in.
targetHint.folders: Removes the tabs above the chat list. The chats themselves stay: a folder is only a view over the list.
targetHint.contacts: Empties the address book. Conversations stay: a contact is a name in a list, not a chat.

cleanup.revokePrivate: Delete on the other side too
cleanup.revokePrivateHint: Telegram allows this in private chats with no time limit. Bots are not affected: a bot keeps its half of the conversation either way.
cleanup.includeArchivedHint: Off by default: an archived chat is already out of the way, and an account arrives with its junk in the main list.
cleanup.warn: This cannot be undone. Leaving a private channel means the invite is gone with it, and a deleted conversation is deleted for good — on this account, and with «delete on the other side too» on theirs as well. Saved Messages is ticked by default: untick it if the previous owner's notes are wanted.
cleanup.nothingToDo: Nothing chosen: tick at least one kind.

refused.empty: Nothing to remove — nothing was chosen.

privacy.title: Privacy settings
privacy.lead: Writes the chosen switches onto {{count}} account(s). Anything left at «leave as is» is not touched: a run that quietly set the ones you did not think about would be a run that opened the account up.
privacy.premiumWarn: Voice messages are a Premium-only switch. On an account without it Telegram refuses this one and every other switch still goes through.
privacy.nothingToDo: Nothing chosen: at least one switch has to move off «leave as is».

refused.empty: Nothing to write — every switch is left as is.

friends.title: Steam friends
friends.lead: Clears the friends list on {{count}} account(s): the previous owner's friends, the invites they were sent and the ones they sent. The account writes to nobody — it simply stops being on their list.

targetHint.friends: Including the ones the previous owner muted — those are friends too.
targetHint.incoming: Declines everything sent to the account.
targetHint.outgoing: Cancels the invites the previous owner sent out.

friends.blockHint: On Steam a block is the removal: the same call ends the relationship. They can no longer message the account or invite it.
friends.noProxy: No proxy is set up for Steam — the whole batch goes out from your IP. Fifty accounts clearing their lists from one address is something Steam notices.
friends.warn: There is no undo: a removed friend has to be added again and confirmed, and a cancelled invite does not come back. A list of two hundred is not instant — the writes are paced, or Steam reads them as a hijack.
friends.nothingToDo: Nothing chosen: tick at least one kind.

refused.empty: Nothing to remove — nothing was chosen.

link.title: Link Steam Guard
link.lead: Attaches the mobile authenticator to {{count}} account(s). The ones that already have it are skipped — no second sign-in happens.
link.warn: The app signs in to Steam once as the mobile app: a device session appears on the account and can only be removed by hand. The run has no undo.
link.spreadHint: Accounts go round-robin through every proxy instead of out from one address.
link.noProxy: No proxy is set up for Steam — the whole batch goes out from your IP. Forty mobile sign-ins from one address in two minutes is what loses accounts.
link.emailHint: If Steam asks for an email code the account is reported in the list and skipped: a run cannot stop and ask. Link those one at a time, from the account card.

refused.empty: Nothing in the selection can be linked.

link.mafileConsent: I understand: for accounts whose shared_secret is not in the item data, the launcher will download the maFile from the market — cancelling those items’ guarantee.

delete.title: Delete from the base
delete.warn: The account's folder goes with the record: the tdata or maFile, the cookies of every session opened from it, the avatar, the authenticator and the last check. The launcher keeps no bin — there will be nothing to restore it from.

stopped.too_many_failures: stopped: too many failures in a row

steam.unlinkedHint: The launcher holds no session for this account, so Steam was never asked anything. Link Guard and the check becomes possible.

detail.refused: Steam turned the stored session down: signed out everywhere, or the authenticator was removed. Link Guard again.
detail.unknown: Steam refused, and the reason could not be placed — the details are in the log.

steamCheck.title: Check Steam accounts
steamCheck.lead: Checks {{count}} account(s): whether the session still works, and what the public profile shows — nickname, bans, join date. No new sign-in appears, no password is needed, nothing on the account is changed.
steamCheck.spreadHint: Accounts go round-robin through every proxy instead of out from one address.
steamCheck.noProxy: No proxy is set up for Steam — the whole batch goes out from your IP. Fifty accounts from one address is something Steam notices.
steamCheck.volatile: The verdict is written into the base folder and survives a restart — it is a snapshot from when the check ran, not what Steam thinks right now.

refused.empty: Nothing in the selection can be checked.

converter.title: Converter
converter.lead: Moves a base from one format to another right on disk: tdata, Telethon and Pyrogram .session, string sessions. Nothing connects to Telegram, and the source folder is left untouched.
converter.nothingFound: No sessions and no tdata in this folder.
converter.withJson: Write a .json sidecar next to each session

telegram.description: Path to the portable Telegram or a compatible fork (AyuGram, Kotatogram, 64Gram). When you sign in, the launcher writes the session next to this file and launches it already logged in.
telegram.pickDialogTitle: Pick the Telegram or fork .exe (portable build)
telegram.statusMissing: Path not set — Telegram login unavailable
telegram.alert: A separate client is recommended — a portable build or fork, not your main Telegram.
telegram.releaseHint: Open the GitHub release page — portable builds and installers
telegram.accountsHint: The official client shows at most 3 accounts (4 with Premium).
telegram.taskConcurrencyHint: How many accounts a run touches at the same time. The lower it is, the calmer it looks from Telegram's side.

localDb.unavailable: Folder is not there — the drive may be unplugged or the folder renamed
localDb.addHint: Pick a folder and the app starts reading it. Every file stays where it is — nothing is moved.
localDb.alert: The database is a plain folder holding telegram and steam subfolders, and inside those, one folder per account with everything known about it. Copy a folder and you have moved that account — or the whole database — to another computer or a flash drive. Passwords, auth_key values and Steam Guard tokens sit in it in the clear, so keep it somewhere nobody else can reach and out of public cloud storage.
localDb.conflictTitle: This folder already has a database
localDb.conflictBody: "{{dir}}" already holds local accounts. Open that database, or replace it with yours?

errors.not_writable: This folder is not writable — pick another one.
errors.missing: The folder is not there — check that the drive is plugged in.
errors.target_exists: This folder already has a database.

steam.title: Steam
steam.invisibleHint: Steam will launch with the "Invisible" status instead of "Online".
steam.autoLaunchHint: Launch the chosen game right after signing into a Steam account.
steam.autoLaunchAppIdHint: Steam App ID of the game to launch.
steam.clearHint: Remove all saved accounts from Steam
steam.confirmBody: Steam will be closed and every saved account and auto-login token removed from this computer. You'll need to sign in again. Your accounts on lzt.market are not affected.

loginMethods.menuHint: Choose the method for accounts that support more than one
loginMethods.hint: What “Sign in” does: ask each time, or go straight with the chosen method.
loginMethods.steamHint: Sign into the Steam client or the in-app browser.
loginMethods.telegramHint: Sign into Telegram Desktop or Telegram Web in the in-app browser. The desktop client needs the path to Telegram.exe in the Telegram settings.
loginMethods.telegramHint_linux: Sign into Telegram Desktop or Telegram Web in the in-app browser. A system-wide install is found automatically.
loginMethods.telegramHint_darwin: Sign in through Telegram Desktop or Telegram Web in the built-in browser. The installed client is found on its own (Telegram Desktop, not the App Store Telegram).

proxy.appHint: Routes lzt.market API requests and the sign-in window. Helps when the site is blocked.
proxy.toggleHint: When signing in you'll be able to pick a proxy from the list
proxy.servicesHint: A proxy will only be offered for the selected services. For Steam, the proxy applies only to browser sign-in.
proxy.forumFailed: Couldn't load proxies from the forum
proxy.bulkPlaceholder: ip:port or ip:port:login:password - one per line
proxy.folderDeleteBody: Folder “{{name}}” holds {{count}} proxy(ies). You can keep them — they'll move to “No folder”.
proxy.folderEmpty: This folder has no proxies yet
proxy.deleteAllConfirmBody: The entire proxy list will be cleared. This action cannot be undone.
proxy.deleteAllFolderBody: {{count}} proxy(ies) will be deleted from “{{name}}”. This action cannot be undone.

bookmarks.barHint: A row under the address bar in every browser window. Add a page with the star in the address bar or {{chord}}.
bookmarks.empty: No bookmarks yet. Open a page in the launcher's browser and click the star in the address bar — or add one here.
bookmarks.fieldTitleNote: Leave it empty to show the site's address.
bookmarks.errorUrl: Enter a site address starting with http:// or https://.
bookmarks.errorFull: There are already {{max}} bookmarks — delete some to add a new one.

extensions.storeLabel: Chrome Web Store link or extension ID
extensions.storePlaceholder: Chrome Web Store link or extension ID
extensions.fromFolderHint: An unpacked extension: the folder that holds manifest.json
extensions.preparingStore: Downloading the extension from the Chrome Web Store and checking it…
extensions.empty: No extensions yet. Paste a Chrome Web Store link — Steam Inventory Helper, for example — or install one from a file or a folder.
extensions.installed: “{{name}}” {{version}} is installed. Pages that are already open need a reload before it works on them.
extensions.updated: “{{name}}” was updated to version {{version}}. Pages that are already open need a reload before the new version works on them.
extensions.removeBody: “{{name}}” will disappear from every browser window, and its files will be deleted from disk.
extensions.note: Changes reach every browser window right away; pages that are already open pick them up after a reload. Extension menus and options open from the Extensions button on the browser toolbar.

preview.title: Install the extension?
preview.reinstall: Version {{version}} is already installed — it will be installed again
preview.allSites: Reads and changes data on all sites
preview.warning: The extension gets full access to the accounts you open in the launcher’s browser: cookies and sessions, trades, personal data. Install only extensions you trust.
preview.fileOverStore: This extension is already installed from the Chrome Web Store. The chosen package or folder will replace it and get all of its data — go ahead only if you trust where it came from.
preview.unsupported: Will not work in the launcher’s browser: {{list}}.

errors.bad_input: This is not a Chrome Web Store extension link or ID. Copy the whole address of the extension’s page.
errors.bad_input_path: Could not open the selected file or folder.
errors.download_failed: Could not download the extension — check your internet connection and try again.
errors.not_found: There is no such extension in the Chrome Web Store — it may have been taken down.
errors.bad_package: This is not a Chrome extension, or the file is damaged.
errors.bad_manifest: Could not read the extension’s manifest.json: it is missing or has an error. For a folder, pick the one that holds manifest.json.
errors.unsupported_manifest: This extension is not supported: Manifest V2 and V3 extensions are, apps and themes are not.
errors.io: Could not write the extension to disk — try again.
errors.expired: The prepared install has expired — start it again.
errors.gone: This extension is no longer installed.

hotkeys.openBookmarkHint: The first nine bookmarks on the bar, left to right. Unlike in Chrome, these keys do not switch tabs.
hotkeys.note: The shortcuts work in the launcher's browser windows while the window is active.

cache.title: Account cache
cache.menuHint: Clear the cache to force a fresh fetch from the market
cache.description: Purchased accounts are cached on disk so the list loads instantly. Clear it to force a fresh fetch from lzt.market.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Connection and app activity logs. Save the file and send it for debugging.

mafile-download.text: Signing in needs the maFile (Steam Guard). Downloading it cancels the item’s active guarantee on lzt.market — permanently. Continue?
